name: Domingo Pérez (Spain)
description: Divided by a chequered band of yellow and red from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white at the lower hoist and blue at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Domingo Pérez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chequered band of yellow and red from the upper hoist to the lower fly
